header: The five modules of Vertex Supply
subheadline: All five modules run on one licence, and you switch them on per team. Most companies start with Dispatch and Field in the first week.

items.title: Dispatch
items.description: The scheduling board: skills, certificates, distance and SLA deadlines in one view. It updates in a median of 1.8 seconds.

items.title: Field
items.description: The technician app for job sheets, photos, parts and signatures. It stores seven days of data, so it works in basement plant rooms.

items.title: Assets
items.description: One register for every serviced unit, with serial number, warranty end date, QR label and full visit history.

items.title: Portal
items.description: Customers see their open calls, planned maintenance dates and signed job sheets without emailing your service desk.

items.title: Insights
items.description: Contract profit, first-time fix rate and travel time per technician, exported weekly to your reporting tools.
